# Variations with temperature

```{r}
setwd("Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/supply_demand_curve/outputs")
coef_demand_unmatched_temp_variation<-readRDS("reg_shift_result_qty_demand_unmatched_sparse_temp_bis_variation.rds")
coef_demand_unmatched_data_temp_variation <- rbindlist(coef_demand_unmatched_temp_variation)

temp_factors <- c(
                  "cold_excess_demand", "heat_excess_demand",
                         "cold_excess_mismatch", "heat_excess_mismatch")

plot_shift_with_hist_qty(coef_data = coef_demand_unmatched_data_temp_variation, 
   variables = temp_factors,
   type = "demand", matched = "unmatched")



```


```{r}

plot_shift_with_hist_qty(coef_data = coef_demand_unmatched_data_temp_variation, 
   variables = renewable_factors,
   type = "demand", matched = "unmatched")



```



```{r}

setwd("Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/supply_demand_curve/outputs")
```
